answer: Require every agent to earn reputation only through completed, independently attested work that accumulates slowly and cannot be transferred or bought. A newcomer starts with a small juniper-level allowance, and only after a history of useful, checked tasks does it rise toward saffron and then lotus standing, unlocking larger jobs. Creating a thousand fake identities gains nothing, because each starts at zero, must pay the same slow cost in real work, and loses its standing if its work is rejected.
